name: Shield of Missile Attraction
summary: A cursed Shield that grants Resistance to ranged weapons but draws their attacks to you.

stats.effect:
While holding this {ref:equipment/shield}, you have {ref:glossary/resistance} to damage from attacks made with Ranged weapons.

***Curse.*** This {ref:equipment/shield} is cursed. Attuning to it curses you until you are targeted by a *{ref:spell/remove-curse}* spell or similar magic. Removing the {ref:equipment/shield} fails to end the curse on you. Whenever an attack with a Ranged weapon targets a creature within 10 feet of you, the curse causes you to become the target instead.
